bundling_rules.description: Only one E/M code may be billed per day per provider at the same facility. Billing 99213 and 99215 (or any two E/M codes) on the same day by the same provider is unbundling.
bundling_rules.violation: Two or more codes from this set billed same day same provider
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual, Chapter 12, Section 30.6.7

bundling_rules.description: Only one ED E/M code may be billed per encounter. Billing 99283 and 99285 together is unbundling.
bundling_rules.violation: Two or more ED E/M codes billed for same encounter
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual, Chapter 12, Section 30.6.9

bundling_rules.description: CPT 85025 (CBC with auto differential) already includes 85027 (CBC without differential). Billing both is unbundling.
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS NCCI Policy Manual Chapter 9 - Pathology

bundling_rules.description: CPT 93000 (ECG routine, 12-lead, with interpretation and report) includes 93005 (ECG tracing only). Cannot bill both.
CPT 71048 (Chest X-ray, 4+ views) includes 71046 (2 views). Cannot bill both for the same encounter.
bundling_rules.violation: Multiple chest X-ray codes billed for same date
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS NCCI Policy Manual Chapter 6 - Radiology

bundling_rules.description: Anesthesia code 00840 includes monitoring codes 99100 and 99116 when performed by the same provider.
bundling_rules.violation: Anesthesia base code billed with qualifying circumstance codes
bundling_rules.correct_code: Anesthesia base code with appropriate qualifying circumstances only if add-on
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual Chapter 12, Anesthesia Services

bundling_rules.description: Surgical procedure 27447 (Total knee arthroplasty) includes arthrotomy 27310. Cannot bill both.
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS NCCI Policy Manual Chapter 5 - Musculoskeletal

bundling_rules.description: Only one initial hospital care code (99221-99223) may be billed per admission. Billing multiple initial hospital codes is unbundling.
bundling_rules.violation: Multiple initial hospital care codes billed for same admission
bundling_rules.correct_code: Single highest-level initial hospital care code
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual Chapter 12, Section 30.6.8

bundling_rules.description: 96374 (Therapeutic IV push, single drug) and 96365 (IV infusion, initial hour) should not both be billed when only one administration method was used.
bundling_rules.violation: Both IV push and IV infusion codes billed when only one method used
bundling_rules.correct_code: 96374 or 96365 based on actual administration method
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual Chapter 12, Section 30.5

bundling_rules.description: CPT 80053 (Comprehensive metabolic panel) already includes individual chemistry tests 82040, 82247, 82248, 82310, 82374, 82435, 82565, 82947, 84132, 84295, 84460, 84450. Billing panel AND individual components is unbundling.
bundling_rules.violation: Comprehensive metabolic panel billed alongside its component tests
bundling_rules.correct_code: 80053 only, do not bill individual components
bundling_rules.cms_reference: CMS NCCI Policy Manual Chapter 9 - Clinical Lab Panel Unbundling

upcoding_patterns.description: 99215 (high complexity E/M, 40+ min) billed for routine follow-up visits that should be 99213 or 99214
99223 (high complexity initial hospital care) billed when documentation only supports 99221 or 99222
99285 (high complexity ED visit) billed for low-acuity ED visits
